attackers_goals: Gain access to the data in the compromised mailbox.
description: An attacker may use an uncommon and unsigned process to access Outlook data files.
investigative_actions: Examine the process command and file activity to identify the mailbox. Check if the process performed any other suspicious file activity. Check if the process generated network connections.
name: Outlook files accessed by an unsigned process
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
